description: This file defines the UriComparator class in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, providing static methods to determine if a modified URL is considered cross-origin relative to an original URL, based on host, scheme, and port comparisons.

classes.name: UriComparator
classes.description: Provides static methods to compare URLs for cross-origin considerations.

methods.name: isCrossOrigin
methods.description: Determines if a modified URL should be considered cross-origin relative to the original URL.

methods.name: computePort
methods.description: Computes the port number for a given URI, defaulting to 443 for HTTPS and 80 otherwise.
